guidance.heading: 2026 Financial Outlook
section:
Dollars in millions, except EPS | 4Q'26E | Full Year 2026E
Net sales | ~$1,825 | ~$7,190
Operating EBITDA(2) | ~$455 | ~$1,785
Adjusted EPS(2) | $1.90 - $1.95 | $7.47 - $7.52

“Our results once again exceeded our financial expectations, demonstrating the strength of our operating model and consistent execution across the businesses. We are again raising our full-year financial outlook and now expect organic growth to be about 4.5%, operating EBITDA to be about $1.785 billion and adjusted EPS to be in the range of $7.47 - $7.52 per share, all at or above the high end of our previously communicated guidance,” said Antonella Franzen, DuPont Chief Financial Officer.

“With continued strength across healthcare, aerospace and industrial water end-markets, we remain well positioned to deliver attractive growth, strong cash generation and effective capital deployment,” Franzen concluded.
